result:
Round 229 (CALM-2a) is implemented within the 16 granted paths, with no STOP and no regression found. The five helper sentences on the timeline and in the video dock are gone, and their facts now sit in tooltips (`title`s). I ran the unit tests, mutants and a short browser check below; the browser acceptance rows are C's, and the full suite, build and `verify` were not run (that is the gate's job).

**What changed**
- **Strings and tempo (`strings.ts`, `tempo.ts`):** the six old strings and `TEMPO_EMPTY_HINT` are deleted. Two new titles were added, both following §2.1: "Loop: make a time selection first (Ctrl+L)" and "Mute — Original video sound".
- **Empty strips:** the BPM strip and the Loop strip now render nothing when there is no tempo or loop.
- **Loop button:** its `title` has three states, so when it is disabled it says why and which key to use.
- **Video dock:**
  - The "Arrangement · Overview" label is gone; the row keeps its 16 px height with `min-h-4`.
  - The caption shows only the video's file name, or nothing when there is no video.
  - The empty monitor is a dark box with no text (`arrangement-video-empty`).
- **Video track:** Mute, Solo and Volume tooltips name "Original video sound" at every lane height. Audio tracks are unchanged.
- **Tests and doc:** the existing test cases B listed were updated, and I added NS6, LSU8, VDS4 and ST-C2a. LSU8 and VDS4 are the full versions, not the fallbacks. Doc 178 is the only new file.

**Checks I ran**
- Typecheck and lint both exited 0. Biome on the 15 granted files is clean.
- The 24 test files covering this change: 421 of 421 passed. No test used more than 27 % of its time limit.
- Mutants: MU-1 to MU-5 each turned the required test red. MU-6 (removing `min-h-4`) turned nothing red, because jsdom does not measure layout, so that check is browser-only (C-BBOX-229).
- Short browser check at 1280×720 on the empty demo:
  - the BPM strip, Loop strip, caption and monitor show no text;
  - the caption row is 16 px high;
  - the empty box exactly covers the video box;
  - the disabled Loop button shows the new title;
  - there were 0 page errors.
- End state: only the 15 granted files are modified plus doc 178. The frozen, root and protected files are unchanged.
- The code-reviewer subagent scored it 9/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings and no Architecture note.

**Open items for B / C**
- **Grep conflict:** the §2.1 check says the deleted-key grep must return 0, but the ST-C2a lines that §2.5 requires (e.g. `'braceHint' in studioLoopStrings`) are the only hits. I followed §2.5; B needs to rule on this.
- **Reviewer Low, proposed for DUX-R-4(b):** keyboard users can't focus a disabled button, so they never see the Loop reason. The suggested fix is `aria-disabled` with the button kept focusable. I didn't do it here because the button's `disabled` is frozen this round.
- **Not checked by me:**
  - the 1440 viewport;
  - the S2, S3 and video (SV) states;
  - whether the native tooltip actually paints.

The full report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-229.md`, and the evidence files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-229/`. The backlog is not marked complete.
